description: This file defines a C# class for an Orleans Stateless Worker grain that supports interleaving, with methods for slow and fast execution patterns and a static method for determining interleaving logic based on method names.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerWithMayInterleaveGrain
classes.description: A stateless grain class with interleave capabilities, implementing methods for slow and fast callbacks, and static logic to determine if requests may interleave.

methods.name: MayInterleaveMethod
methods.description: A static method that returns true if the invoked method is 'GoFast', indicating that requests to this method can interleave.

methods.name: GoSlow
methods.description: An asynchronous method that invokes a callback to wait, representing a slow processing task.

methods.name: GoFast
methods.description: An asynchronous method that invokes a callback to wait, representing a fast processing task.
